$comment: Hand-maintained input for scripts/gen-profile-readme.mjs, which regenerates the
repo table in profile/README.md between the BEGIN:repos / END:repos markers.
THIS FILE IS PUBLIC. It must name ONLY public repos. Private repos never reach
the generator (it fetches ?type=public), so there is nothing to exclude — and an
entry in `exclude` would leak a private name just as effectively as a table row.
Every public, non-archived repo in the org must appear in exactly one of
`sections[].repos` or `exclude`, or the generator exits non-zero. That hard
failure is the point: a new repo turns the daily workflow red until someone
classifies it, so it can never silently go missing from github.com/DisplayXR.
use the live GitHub repo description), `indent` (optional, renders as a nested
sub-row under the entry above it).
